relations: Gentle air motion makes fronds and leaflets flutter while the trunk and lower stems stay fixed.
Pivoting fronds at their attachment points continuously reshape the open sky gaps between them.
Moving leaflets rearrange the bright sun filtering through gaps while the sun's right-edge position holds.
Backlit leaflets turn translucent as they drift, flickering the light pattern without new events.
caption: The video captures a backlit palm viewed from below against a clear blue sky, its dark fronds arching across the scene from a trunk at the lower center-right. The sun glares near the right edge, shining through the leaflets and turning some translucent. The fronds and their leaflets sway and flutter gently throughout, an ongoing motion already present at the beginning. The drooping left frond and the central arching frond shift orientation in small continuous ways, while the trunk and lower stems remain largely fixed. As the leaves move, the pattern of bright sun filtering through the gaps flickers and rearranges, though the sun's position on the right edge remains roughly constant. The open sky between the fronds subtly changes shape as the foliage drifts. The view holds a steady play of light and leaf without resolving into any new event.
